contributor to MP (1856-90), novelist

Daughter of the Reverend Richard Carter Smith (1802-1864) and Mary Williamson.

The letters indicate that at some point Ann Carter Smith had lived in Norway and that she had a brother in the navy. [wills index, left £40,997, probate to Cecil Newton Goodhall; parish register]
